scenarios.description: An actual Monster Reborn target choice distinguishes identical names in both Graveyards. Choosing the opposing label revives that copy and leaves both own copies in the GY.

Official Polymerization distinguishes identical materials in hand/field and genuinely places Ultimate into own shared Extra Zone 2. Two Galaxy-Eyes then properly Xyz Summon Exblowrer, whose genuine opposing-field zone choice selects shared Extra Zone 1 (opposing wire sequence 6) and destroys that Ultimate.

Actual Mystical Space Typhoon differentiates two opposing facedown zones without exposing either identity and destroys zone three. Book of Moon then differentiates identically named monsters in the two shared Extra Monster Zones using the viewer board mapping and flips the opposing copy.

Two official Magical Exemplars genuinely gain two Spell Counters each after Umi. The real Anti-Spell cost asks successive per-card choices with distinct zone labels; [0,2] leaves zone one at two and removes only zone three counters, then negates and destroys Pot of Greed.
